description: A private DigitalOcean Spaces bucket: S3-compatible object storage for files, backups and static assets, used with any S3 tool or SDK. Pick this when the user needs to store files rather than run a server or a database. The bucket is always private (no public-read; nothing can be read without a key), and the user gets an access key that works on this bucket only. Destroying the bucket deletes everything in it. Spaces is billed as a $5 a month subscription on the account, which is shared by all its buckets, so tell the user the bucket's cost is part of that.
costHint: About $5 a month: the account's Spaces subscription (250 GiB storage and 1 TiB outbound transfer, shared by all buckets), plus $0.02 per GiB stored and $0.01 per GiB transferred beyond that.

variables.name: name
variables.label: Name
variables.description: Bucket name: 3 to 54 characters, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit. A short suffix from the request is added to it, and the result becomes part of the bucket's address (<name>-<suffix>.<region>.digitaloceanspaces.com), so don't put anything private in it.

variables.name: region
variables.label: Region
variables.description: Datacenter: nyc3 (New York), sfo3 (San Francisco), ams3 (Amsterdam), lon1 (London), fra1 (Frankfurt) or sgp1 (Singapore). The price is the same in every region.

variables.name: project_request_id
variables.label: Project
variables.description: Optional: the request ID of one of the user's projects to put this in. Without one, it goes in the account's default project.

outputs.name: name
outputs.description: The bucket's full name, with the request's suffix.

outputs.name: endpoint
outputs.description: The region's S3 endpoint hostname, such as nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com; use https://<endpoint> as the endpoint URL in S3 tools.

outputs.name: access_key_id
outputs.description: Access key ID of a key that can read, write and delete objects in this bucket only.
